parameters.name: api_password
parameters.description: The password or token for XMLRPC authentication. If not specified then the value of the ONE_PASSWORD environment variable, if any, is used.

parameters.name: api_url
parameters.description: The ENDPOINT URL of the XMLRPC server. If not specified then the value of the ONE_URL environment variable, if any, is used.

parameters.name: api_username
parameters.description: The name of the user for XMLRPC authentication. If not specified then the value of the ONE_USERNAME environment variable, if any, is used.

parameters.name: im_mad_name
parameters.description: The name of the information manager, this values are taken from the oned.conf with the tag name IM_MAD (name). Default: "kvm"

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Hostname of the machine to manage.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Takes the host to the desired lifecycle state. If absent the host is deleted from the cluster. If present the host is created in the cluster (includes enabled, disabled and offline states). If enabled the host is fully operational. disabled, for example to perform maintenance operations. offline, host is totally offline. Choices: "absent" "present" ← (default) "enabled" "disabled" "offline"

parameters.name: template
parameters.description: The template or attribute changes to merge into the host template.

parameters.name: validate_certs
parameters.description: Whether to validate the TLS/SSL certificates or not. This parameter is ignored if PYTHONHTTPSVERIFY environment variable is used. Choices: false true ← (default)

parameters.name: vmm_mad_name
parameters.description: The name of the virtual machine manager mad name, this values are taken from the oned.conf with the tag name VM_MAD (name). Default: "kvm"

parameters.name: wait_timeout
parameters.description: Time to wait for the desired state to be reached before timeout, in seconds. Default: 300

examples:
- name: Create a new host in OpenNebula
  community.general.one_host:
    name: host1
    cluster_id: 1
    api_url: http://127.0.0.1:2633/RPC2

- name: Create a host and adjust its template
  community.general.one_host:
    name: host2
    cluster_name: default
    template:
      LABELS:
        - gold
        - ssd
      RESERVED_CPU: -100
